notes: Per site, main run (zero-floored GPP_NT_VUT_REF, calendar years, GSL_SITES' own years, no winter screen). near_zero_share_<c>pct = share of pooled daily GPP < c% of P99 (c = 0.5, 1, 2). partial_skew_ge_<c>pct = adjusted Fisher-Pearson skewness (g1_adjusted(), 03_derive.R) of only the days with GPP >= c% of P99. skewness = full-distribution skewness (derived_site.csv), for comparison. sensitivity_iqr_{mean,sd,trend}_gsl = interquartile range, across Tash's 22-point threshold grid (0.1%, 0.5%, 1-20% of P99), of that grid's per-threshold mean GSL / across-year GSL standard deviation / across-year GSL trend slope (lm(gsl ~ year) at each threshold). t85_pct/t95_pct = selected threshold at target shares 0.85/0.95 (duration_curve_crossings.csv).
